integrity: The universal argument uses the mapping-torus projection degree, excision, the Thom isomorphism, the pair long exact sequence, and Smith normal form. The bundled finite checker is supplementary and is not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only ordinary integral first homology of the branch-surface exterior, not its nonabelian fundamental group or higher-order invariants.
Different Weierstrass orbit partitions can have the same component count and gcd, so the invariant need not classify branch surfaces.
title: First homology of hyperelliptic branch complements
